The best linear fits (cubic in A times 1, t, t², sqrt(t) and 1/t terms) reach about 3e-6 but still do not hit the 1e-12 target, so the time dependence likely contains a nonlinear parameter I did not identify.

import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    return (params[0] + params[1]*A + params[2]*A**2 + params[3]*A**3
            + t*(params[4] + params[5]*A + params[6]*A**2)
            + params[7]*t**2 + params[8]*A*t**2 + params[9]*np.sqrt(t))
